content: TimescaleDB continuous aggregates (CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... WITH (timescaledb.continuous) AS SELECT time_bucket(...) ... WITH NO DATA) precompute GROUP BY rollups, refresh incrementally via add_continuous_aggregate_policy(view, start_offset, end_offset, schedule_interval). Real-time aggregation is DISABLED by default since v2.13+ -- must opt in via materialized_only=false for up-to-the-second accuracy. Hierarchical caggs (hourly built on raw, daily/weekly/monthly built on hourly) avoid scanning raw rows for wide time ranges.
